diffusion_architecture.definition: Score-based generative model using forward/reverse diffusion process for 3D coordinate generation
key_components: Forward process: Gaussian noise addition with cosine schedule
Reverse process: Learned denoising network predicts noise
deviations: Using fewer timesteps (100 vs typical 1000) for CPU efficiency
Using DDIM instead of full DDPM sampling for speed

se3_equivariance.definition: Network outputs transform properly under rotation and translation
key_components: Invariant attention weights from distance-based features
Equivariant coordinate updates using direction vectors
deviations: Approximate equivariance through distance bias rather than full SE(3) convolution

multi_modal_encoding.definition: Unified representation for protein, nucleic acid, and small molecule inputs
key_components: Separate encoders per modality with shared representation space

transformer_attention.definition: Multi-head self-attention for capturing long-range dependencies

evoformer_inspired_pairwise.definition: Pairwise feature update using outer product and triangular operations
key_components: Outer product of single features for pairwise update
